handbookNote: The Boater's Guide of Arizona (the official boating handbook developed for the Arizona Game and Fish Department, AZGFD) and Arizona Revised Statutes Title 5, Chapter 3 (Boating and Water Sports) -- unlike most states in this rollout, Arizona has NO general age-based mandatory boater-education law: ARS Title 5 Ch.3's own section index contains no boater-education requirement, and AZGFD-approved vendor pages (Boat-Ed and iLearnToBoat Arizona) both state outright that boating education 'is not required in Arizona,' making it optional/recommended rather than mandated; where those same AZGFD-approved vendors DO converge is on course mechanics -- an 80% passing score on the final certification exam with unlimited retake attempts (Boat-Ed and iLearnToBoat both confirm 80%), though the exact final-exam question count is not consistently published by either vendor and is therefore left unconfirmed rather than asserted; the real, verified nuance is interstate jurisdiction on Arizona's biggest boating destinations -- the National Park Service states plainly that on Lake Mead/Lake Mohave (Lake Mead NRA, shared with Nevada) a boater 'is responsible for complying with the laws of both states,' so an Arizona boater can still be bound by Nevada's own birth-date-gated education mandate (motor >15hp, born on/after 1/1/1983) and Nevada's stricter 14-year PWC age minimum, with a reciprocal AZ-registered-boat exemption from Nevada's AIS decal; similarly on Lake Powell (Glen Canyon NRA, shared with Utah) the NPS flags Utah's own certification requirement for 12-17-year-old PWC operators as distinct from Arizona's general rule -- content also grounded directly in Arizona Revised Statutes 5-331 (PFDs), 5-341 (operator age/PWC), 5-343 (speed/wake), 5-395/5-396/5-397 (BUI, 0.08 standard / 0.04 commercial), 5-349 (accident reporting: >$500 property damage within 5 days, death/injury within 48 hours), and 5-321/5-322 (AZGFD registration) -- price matches this project's Motorcycle-tier boating convention ($7.99), not a placeholder
